description:
Start Companies helps people who live outside the United States form a US LLC and keep it in good standing.

Ask about opening a company and the plugin compares the three formation packages, recommends the one that fits the state and number of members, and records a formation request so a team member can follow up by email. It also explains the annual renewal, including the IRS filings a foreign-owned LLC must file each year, and the cost and requirements of an ITIN for founders without a Social Security Number.

No payment is requested or processed in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Quiero abrir una LLC en Estados Unidos y no soy residente, ¿qué paquete me conviene?
